name: Warm & Fuzzy
one_liner: Single portfolio site of Warm & Fuzzy, a US creative, animation and VFX studio; reference for a video-led studio site.
what_it_offers: A studio website, not a resource. Warm & Fuzzy (founded 2016; team of about 12; LA, Boulder and NYC) shows work for Dunkin', ampm, Crocs, Conair, Olipop, McLaren F1, Pearl Jam, Bose, Coca-Cola, Porsche, Under Armour and others, across creative direction, production, live experiences, design, animation, VFX, editorial/finishing, sound and AI/emerging tech. The useful part is the site itself, designed and built by Neutral Studio and named Awwwards Site of the Day on Sept 12, 2026 (7.26/10). It has a video-first grid of Mux-streamed thumbnails, Category and Client filter dropdowns on the Work page, smooth scrolling, intro and idle animations, and a playful, minimal Work/Info/Contact structure.
tech_stack: Next.js (Turbopack build) on Vercel + Storyblok CMS + Mux video/thumbnails + Lenis smooth scroll
portfolio_fit_reason: An Awwwards Site of the Day studio portfolio that works as a direct model for a video-led work page. It's a single reference with no reusable code, and its look suits motion studios best.
client_ok_note: © 2026 Warm And Fuzzy LLC, and client work belongs to the studio and its clients. Study the patterns only; don't copy video, imagery, copy or code.
best_use_for_portfolio: Use it as the model for a studio or motion-designer work page: a grid of muted, autoplaying video with poster thumbnails, Category and Client filter dropdowns, Lenis smooth scrolling and a short Work/Info/Contact nav. Rebuild the pattern in Next.js with Mux or native video, and keep an eye on page weight.
tier_reason: A single award-winning studio site that models a video-led work page well. No reusable code, and its approach suits motion studios best.
pick_over_overlaps: Use it when building a video-led studio or portfolio on a similar stack. Otherwise Awwwards covers this job.
score_rationale: A polished, Awwwards SOTD-winning example of a video-led creative-studio site, built on a common Next.js-on-Vercel stack with Storyblok, Mux and Lenis. It's good for motion, grid and filter patterns, but it's a single site with no reusable code or assets.
free_tier: The whole public site is free to view; nothing to buy.
commercial_use_license: No license: © 2026 Warm And Fuzzy LLC, and client work is owned by the studio and its clients. Study the layout and interaction patterns only; don't copy the videos, imagery, copy or code.
agent_friendly: None found (llms.txt 404, no API or registry). An agent can only fetch or screenshot the public pages as visual reference, and much of the content is video.
maintenance_signal: Current. Awwwards Site of the Day on Sept 12, 2026; © 2026 footer; 2025-2026 projects (Dunkin' Pumpkin Spice, San Diego Zoo Elephant Valley, Crocs 2025) on the Work page; live Vercel deployment. The CSS Design Awards listing (WOTD Feb 4, 2022, 8.08) covers an earlier version of the site by Stephen Hannon (now co-founder of Neutral Studio) with Thomas Aufresne.
caveats: Filed under 'Inspiration gallery' to fit the taxonomy, but it is one studio's portfolio site, not a gallery, resource or tool. The video-heavy layout carries performance and bandwidth costs, and the look suits motion/VFX studios more than product or SaaS sites. Everything is copyrighted. The CSSDA award is for the site's 2022 version, not the current build.
